sentences.en: The results of the term examination were anything but satisfactory.
sentences.zh: 期中考试的结果远非令人满意。

sentences.en: Whomever you may ask, you can't get a satisfactory answer.
sentences.zh: 无论你问谁，都得不到一个满意的答复。

sentences.en: For these patients, surgical treatment is far from being satisfactory.
sentences.zh: 对于这些病人来说，手术治疗远远不够令人满意。

senses.zh: 令人满意的，合适的；（病人）未恶化的，没有生命危险的；（证据，判决）满足案情需要的；赎罪的
